postal_system.assignment_rule: The complete 39,192-row La Poste snapshot contains 38 MQ assignment rows, 30 distinct postal codes, 34 distinct COG 2026 communes and 35 distinct postcode-to-commune pairs.
postal_system.geometry_rule: La Poste does not supply open postal-code contours. Every MQ pair is joined by exact INSEE identity to an unmodified geo.api.gouv.fr commune Polygon or MultiPolygon and remains derived display geometry, never an official postal boundary.
postal_system.shared_surface_rule: 97218, 97222 and 97250 return multiple real commune surfaces without union or fabrication; 97200 and 97234 both map to Fort-de-France and retain the same surface; three multi-Ligne-5 groups remain one postal identity per code.
postal_system.territory_exclusion_rule: MQ remains Martinique identity 972; no other country or territory is reassigned or merged by postal prefix.
postal_system.non_area_rule: No point, route, P.O. box or organisation object is expanded into an area.
postal_system.address_rule: No address, building, parcel, recipient, customer, delivery or land-rights row is bundled. Postal Code to Polygon to Address Context authority remains separated.
postal_system.agid_rule: Postal nodes and derived commune surfaces are linked only inside the versioned Postal Context graph. AGID identity, addresses and buildings require independent explicit evidence.

temporal_model.valid_time: Assignments are represented from the 2026-08-08 official La Poste data update.
temporal_model.known_time: Retrieval time, exact source bodies, edition, digests and AGID release time are recorded separately.
temporal_model.history_rule: A later assignment or boundary edition creates a new release and never rewrites this evidence.

quality_gates.pass: The official snapshot has exactly 38 MQ rows, 30 postcodes, 34 commune identities and 35 postcode/commune pairs.
All 30 fixed postcode queries return exactly their expected 35 MQ commune features and coordinates equal the 34-feature department response.
All 35 published Polygon/MultiPolygon responses pass Turf, JSTS, ring closure, range and 20,000-position gates without coordinate modification.
97218/97222/97250 remain multiple surfaces, 97200/97234 share Fort-de-France, and three multi-Ligne-5 groups remain disclosed.
The real pack passes normalization, ambiguous API lookup, metadata, bounds fit, translucent paint, clear, re-search, no-match and invalid-code tests.
No address, building, parcel, recipient, customer or land-rights data is published.

stages.definition: Source roles, rights and blockers are inventoried.
Country-specific contracts and provenance are reviewable.

The complete current La Poste snapshot proves all 30 MQ postcode identities from 38 rows and 35 code-commune pairs; fixed Open Licence 2.0 geo.api.gouv.fr department and per-postcode responses supply exact valid real commune geometry. Only derived administrative display context is published, with multi-commune, same-commune and Ligne 5 exceptions disclosed, while the real API/app normalizes, returns multiple candidates, renders, fits, clears and re-searches with provenance.
A source refresh and independent review pass without authority drift.
Two source refreshes pass with monitored rollback.
